bio.text: Ed Harbison, of Columbus, was first elected to the Georgia Senate from the 15th District in 1992.
Born in Prattville, Alabama, and raised in Montgomery, Harbison served four years in the U.S. Marines and received the Purple Heart.

Before the Senate, Harbison served on the Muscogee County School Board and the Columbus Charter Review Commission; the biography describes Harbison as a public relations and advertising consultant and broadcast journalist.
